data.narrative:
Lightelligence is a public-stage semiconductor company founded by Shen Yichen, Marin Soljačić, Huaiyu Meng, and Spencer Powers, having raised $310M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 4 same-sector, same-stage comparables in Chips & Semiconductors: Cerebras ($39.2B), Credo Semiconductor ($35.8B), Ouster ($2.3B), and Aeva Technologies ($1.1B).

The peer-median method is the primary applicable triangulation approach. The median valuation across these four public semiconductor peers is $19.0B, with a range spanning $1.1B to $39.2B. Public-comp anchoring using semiconductor sector P/S multiples (20.5x median across ALAB, NVDA, AMD) cannot be applied, as Lightelligence's revenue is not on file—typical for private companies.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $16.2B to $21.9B, centered on the peer median of $19.0B. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion within the comparable set (35x difference between min and max), which reflects heterogeneous market valuations for semiconductor startups at public stage. The absence of revenue data prevents multiples-based validation. The strength of this valuation rests on same-stage peer selection; however, the substantial variance among peers suggests material sensitivity to company-specific execution and market positioning factors not captured in this analysis.
